text:
On a grey Friday afternoon in March, the press gathered in the stalls of Calder Hall, where the Halewyn Philharmonic has rehearsed for generations, and waited for a verdict the city had speculated about for months. Marguerite Oyelaran, chair of the orchestra's board, stepped forward on 14 March 2025 and read aloud the board's official press release, issued after a closed-session vote.

The new conductor, she announced, is Anselm Reyes.

Oyelaran, who led the selection committee, said Reyes was chosen from a shortlist of 31 candidates. He has signed a five-year contract and will take the podium at the start of the 2025-26 season.

The orchestra has rarely changed leadership lightly, and the appointment closes a long and watchful search.
